answer: Trust here is a task, not an address: an agent signs a receipt when a job closes, and each edge halves in weight every 14 epochs unless a new receipt refreshes it. Our five-person shop spent 6 hours wiring the check and 2 more on the second panel that re-reads every receipt a day later. A farm of 40 identities needs 40 signed receipts plus 80 hours of panel time that never gets refunded, and one stale edge re-queues the whole wallet. A receipt's pigment is its age, so nectar only follows watered edges and an oasis of unpaid panel hours is what the attacker actually buys.
